cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the taxpayer number is the national ID number or checked against it. TCD-004 (January 2025) calls eTax registration a pilot; the newer TCD-002 has the NIF verifiable online.
cells.note: The NIF is issued through E-Tax and, per the customs directorate in 2025, is required on every customs declaration, which SYDONIA blocks without one. Nothing found ties it to the national ID, so stage 5 is not met.
